mapper.select: /* sampleboard-mapper.xml id="selectSampleBoardView" 샘플게시판 단건 조회 */ SELECT seq , mb_id , title , content , writer_nm , DATE_FORMAT(in_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS in_dtm , DATE_FORMAT(up_dtm, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS up_dtm FROM tbts_sample_board WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND seq = #{seq} AND use_yn = 'Y'
